examples.text: n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī bhavissan'ti maññitam'etaṃ. maññitaṃ, bhikkhave, rogo, maññitaṃ gaṇḍo, maññitaṃ sallaṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, amaññamānena cetasā viharissāmā'ti, evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

38861.sanskrit: na + eva + saṃjñin + na + asaṃjñin + vāda

examples.text: apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā katamehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti? soḷasa saññīvādā, aṭṭha asaññīvādā, aṭṭha n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā, satta ucchedavādā, pañca diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā, apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā imehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti.

38862.meaning1: holding the doctrine of neither percipient nor non-percipient (post-mortem existence)
38862.meaning2: holding the doctrine of neither percipient nor impercipient (post-mortem existence)
38862.commentary: (PMa) n'evasaññī-n'āsaññiṃ vadantī'ti n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā. atha vā saññī'ti pavatto vādo saññīvādo, so yesaṃ atthī'ti te saññīvādā, tathā asaññīvādā, n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā ca.
38862.sanskrit: na + eva + saṃjñin + na + asaṃjñin + vāda

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā uddham'āghātanikā n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā, uddham'āghātanaṃ n'evasaññī-n'āsaññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti aṭṭhahi vatthūhi.

38863.meaning1: neither pleasant; neither nice; neither agreeable; neither appealing

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, upekkh'indriyaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā n'evasātaṃ n'āsātaṃ vedayitaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, upekkh'indriyaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañc'indriyānī'ti.

38864.meaning1: of neither a trainee nor one beyond training; i.e. common

examples.text: tisso paññā, sekkhā paññā, asekkhā paññā, n'evasekkhān'āsekkhā paññā.

38865.meaning1: who is neither a trainee nor is beyond training; i.e. who does not train
38865.commentary: (ADHa) avaseso puthujjanabhikkhu tisso sikkhā n'eva sikkhati, na sikkhitvā ṭhito'ti n'evasekkha-n'āsekkho'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: tayo puggalā, sekkho puggalo, asekkho puggalo, n'evasekkho-n'āsekkho puggalo.

38866.meaning1: not even for him; not even his; neither his

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnaṃ ce'pi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, n'ev'assa taṃ hoti antarāyāya.
yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati n'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
atha kho, bhikkhave, bako brahmā antaradhāyissāmi samaṇassa gotamassa, antaradhāyissāmi samaṇassa gotamassā'ti n'eva'ssu me sakkoti antaradhāyituṃ

38870.commentary: (ANa) āgataviso na ghoraviso'ti yassa visaṃ āgacchati, ghoraṃ pana na hoti, cirakālaṃ na pīḷeti.

examples.text: katame cattāro? āgataviso na ghoraviso, ghoraviso na āgataviso, āgataviso ca ghoraviso ca, n'ev'āgataviso na ghoraviso, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvisā. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āsīvis'ūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.

38871.commentary: (MNa) nevāpiko'ti yo migānaṃ gahaṇ'atthāya araññe tiṇabījāni vapati, idaṃ tiṇaṃ khādituṃ āgate mige sukhaṃ gaṇhissāmī'ti.

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, nevāpiko nivāpaṃ nivapati migajātānaṃ, imaṃ me nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ migajātā paribhuñjantā dīgh'āyukā vaṇṇavanto ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ yāpentū'ti.

38872.meaning1: followers of the baiter; trapper's gang

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, nevāpikassa ca nevāpikaparisāya ca etadahosi, saṭhāssunām'ime tatiyā migajātā ketabino, iddhimantāssunām'ime tatiyā migajātā parajanā, imañ'ca nāma nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ paribhuñjanti, na ca nesaṃ jānāma āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā.
te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā sen'āsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno, n'ev'āhaṃ āpanno'mhi, na pan'āhaṃ āpanno'mhī'ti so tuṇhībhāvena saṅghaṃ viheṭheti.

nissitassa calitaṃ, anissitassa calitaṃ n'atthi. calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati nati na hoti. natiyā asati āgatigati na hoti. āgatigatiyā asati cut'ūpapāto na hoti. cut'ūpapāte asati n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha tato tvaṃ bāhiya n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena

38877.meaning1: no one; not one; none; nobody

examples.text: yassa jitaṃ n'āvajīyati, jitaṃ yassa no yāti koci loke, taṃ buddham'anantagocaraṃ, apadaṃ kena padena nessatha.

no ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhena kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, tassa bhavanti vattāro, iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro
no ce kira diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, sīlabbaten'āpi na suddhim'āha, adiṭṭhiyā assutiyā añāṇā, asīlatā abbatā no'pi tena, maññām'ahaṃ momuham'eva dhammaṃ, diṭṭhiyā eke paccenti suddhiṃ.

38879.meaning1: even if not; even if one doesn't

examples.text: no ce'pi uccākulā pabbajito hoti, so ca hoti dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so tattha pujjo, so tattha pāsaṃso'ti.

ime kho, cunda, dasa akusalakammapathā. imehi kho, cunda, dasahi akusalehi kammapathehi samannāgato kālass'eva uṭṭhahanto'va sayanamhā pathaviṃ ce'pi āmasati, asuci'y'eva hoti. no ce'pi pathaviṃ āmasati, asuci'y'eva hoti

38880.meaning1: could it be otherwise?; why not?

examples.text: kathañ'hi no siyā, bhante! idān'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto'ti.
kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, ñāṇadassanavisuddh'atthaṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, aggivessana, api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ, udake nikkhittaṃ, uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyyā'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo accāyatā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu te davāya vā āhāraṃ āhāreyyuṃ, madāya vā āhāraṃ āhāreyyuṃ, maṇḍanāya vā āhāraṃ āhāreyyuṃ, vibhūsanāya vā āhāraṃ āhāreyyun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante
saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo udāhu no'ti?
ādittasmiṃ agārasmiṃ, yaṃ nīharati bhājanaṃ, taṃ tassa hoti atthāya, no ca yaṃ tattha ḍayhati.

38884.meaning1: (adds a question mark) surely?; didn't?; isn't it?; definitely?
38884.commentary: (DNa) abhijānāsi no tvan'ti abhijānāsi nu tvaṃ. ayañ'ca no-saddo parato pucchitā'ti padena yojetabbo.

examples.text: assuttha no tumhe, bhikkhave, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ jarasiṅgālassa vassamānassā'ti
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapetvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ parittaṃ udak'āvasesaṃ udak'ādhāne ṭhapitan'ti?
kassa no tvaṃ, cunda, soceyyāni rocesī'ti?
santi loke munayo, janā vadanti ta'y'idaṃ kathaṃsu, ñāṇ'ūpapannaṃ no muniṃ vadanti, udāhu ve jīviten'ūpapannaṃ.
kiṃ nu kho mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa evam'ārocimha, imāsañ'ca imāsañ'ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ mayaṃ lābhino'ti yaṃ no āyasmā anuruddho bhagavato sammukhā yāva āsavānaṃ khayā pakāsetī'ti?
āyām'āvuso, yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamissāma. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocessāma. yathā no bhagavā byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāressāmā'ti.
kassako paṭijānāsi, na ca passāma te kasiṃ, kasiṃ no pucchito brūhi, yathā jānemu te kasiṃ.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kāyagatā sati no bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā'ti.
n'atthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyan'ti

ko sujjhati muccati bajjhatī ca, ken'attanā gacchati brahmalokaṃ, ajānato me muni brūhi puṭṭho, bhagavā hi me sakkhi brahmajjadiṭṭho, tuvañ'hi no brahmasamo'si saccaṃ, kathaṃ upapajjati brahmalokaṃ jutima.
taṃ kissa hetu? na hi no etaṃ, bhante, attā vā attaniyaṃ vā'ti

etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.

38890.meaning1: not valuing worldly gain; not giving weight to material benefit
38890.commentary: (ANa) āmisagarū'ti catupaccayagarukā lok'uttaradhammaṃ lāmakato gahetvā ṭhitaparisā. saddhammagarū'ti nava lok'uttaradhamme garuke katvā cattāro paccaye lāmakato gahetvā ṭhitaparisā. (ANt) sattame kilesehī āmasitabbato āmisaṃ, cattāro paccayā. tadeva garu garukātabbaṃ etesaṃ, na dhammo'ti āmisagarū. ten'āha lok'uttaradhammaṃ lāmakato gahetvā ṭhitaparisā'ti.

examples.text: te taṃ lābhaṃ labhitvā agathitā amucchitā anajjhosannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saddhammagaru parisā noāmisagaru. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve parisā.

katamā ca, bhikkhave, paṭipucchāvinītā parisā nookkācitavinītā? idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū ye te sutt'antā kavitā kāveyyā citt'akkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti.
